SF_USER_NEBULA

userData key under which makeNebulaSprite parks the animation record (SFNebulaFx) — bodies-scene lifts it onto the node so updateFx can swirl/breathe the layers without the sprite factory changing its return contract.

makeNebulaSprite

Billboard sprite for nebulae and star clusters — the real photo on a camera-facing sprite with feathered edges and source aspect ratio preserved. Additive blending + tint only on the procedural fallback, where the glow texture stands in for imagery.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry (texture = photo URL, color = fallback tint).
  • @param texMap Loaded texture map keyed by URL.
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-gradient glow texture (may be undefined).

makeGalaxyDisc

Tilted photographic disc for an external galaxy — the real image on a plane lying in the body's disc plane, edge-feathered so it melts into the skybox. The group's tilt (def.tilt) still applies; the spin field rotates the photo in-plane, reading as the galaxy's true rotation. Non-photo defs keep the soft glow disc.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog galaxy entry.
  • @param texMap Loaded texture map keyed by URL.
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-gradient glow texture (may be undefined).
  • @param localTilt Extra tilt in radians — callers whose parent group
